card.name: Group subject awaiting its own action
card.fires_on: Words right after a group or named subject (a dynasty, a company, 'we', 'our group') where the next word will describe what that group itself did or owns. Often a verb, comma, or linking word.

modes.label: Verb after group subject
modes.description: The verb or word that follows a collective subject such as a dynasty or two countries.
modes.example: Sima Qian was hostile to the Qin Emperor partly because his dynasty<< replaced>> that of the Qin, and his history

modes.label: We after a lead-in
modes.description: The word 'we' after a clause or 'and', introducing what the authors or group did together.
modes.example: I showed Historypin.com to the boys and<< we>> explored the site, discussed photos we’d

modes.label: Linking word after group
modes.description: A preposition or noun right after a group, leading into its actions or traits.
modes.example: They were renowned in the ancient world<< for>> their valor in battle.

card.writes: It favors words meaning 'himself', 'for oneself' and 'personally', and suppresses 'collectively' and 'mutually'.
card.plain: It marks spots where a group or person is about to be described acting on their own behalf.
